blocks.text: Yeh Unit 13 (Differentiation) ke poore unit se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke Section-II ke sawal ke hisse ki shakal mein: har sawal 5 number ka hai (lamba sawal, saboot (proof) ya derivation). Har sawal poore qadmon ke saath hal kiya gaya hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Find, by using \(m_{\text{tan}} = \lim_{\delta x \to 0}\dfrac{f(x+\delta x) - f(x)}{\delta x}\), the gradient and an equation of the tangent line to \(f(x) = x^{2} + 2x\) at \(P(1, 3)\). Show that the tangent meets the curve only at \(P\). (5 marks)
(\(m_{\text{tan}}\) ki limit se \(f(x) = x^{2} + 2x\) ki \(P(1, 3)\) par tangent ka gradient aur equation nikalein. Dikhayein ke tangent curve ko sirf \(P\) par milti hai.)
blocks.explanation: Pehle dekhein \(P\) curve par hai, limit mein \(x = 1\) rakhein, \(\delta x\) cancel karein, phir point-slope form.

book_ref.quote: the line touches the curve at \(P\) and does not cut it again

blocks.final_answer: Gradient \(= 4\); tangent \(y = 4x - 1\), jo curve ko sirf \(P(1, 3)\) par chhooti hai.

blocks.prompt:
2 For \(f(x) = x^{3}\), find the average rate of change from \(x = 1\) to \(x = 1 + \delta x\). Evaluate it for \(\delta x = 0.1\) and \(\delta x = 0.01\), and find the instantaneous rate of change at \(x = 1\). (5 marks)
(\(f(x) = x^{3}\) ki \(x = 1\) se \(x = 1 + \delta x\) tak average rate of change nikalein. \(\delta x = 0.1\) aur \(\delta x = 0.01\) ke liye qeemat nikalein, aur \(x = 1\) par instantaneous rate of change nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Average rate = difference quotient; \(\delta x \to 0\) par us ki limit instantaneous rate hai.

book_ref.quote: If \(x_{1}\) approaches \(x\), then

blocks.final_answer: Average rate \(3 + 3\delta x + \delta x^{2}\) (\(3.31\), \(3.0301\)); \(x = 1\) par instantaneous rate \(3\), yaani \(f'(1) = 3\).

blocks.prompt:
3 A particle moves along a line with position \(s(t) = 2t^{2} + 3t + 1\) metres after \(t\) seconds. Find (i) the average velocity over \([1, 4]\) and (ii) the instantaneous velocity at \(t = 2\) by the limit. (5 marks)
(Aik particle ki position \(t\) second baad \(s(t) = 2t^{2} + 3t + 1\) metres hai. (i) \([1, 4]\) par average velocity aur (ii) limit se \(t = 2\) par instantaneous velocity nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: (i) mein average formula, (ii) mein limit wala formula.

book_ref.quote: the average velocity becomes the instantaneous velocity

blocks.prompt:
4 Using \(f'(a) = \lim_{x \to a}\dfrac{f(x) - f(a)}{x - a}\), find the derivative of \(f(x) = \dfrac{1}{x}\) at \(x = a\) (\(a \ne 0\)). Hence find the gradient of the curve at \(x = 2\). (5 marks)
(\(f'(a) = \lim_{x \to a}\dfrac{f(x) - f(a)}{x - a}\) se \(f(x) = \dfrac{1}{x}\) ka \(x = a\) (\(a \ne 0\)) par derivative nikalein. Phir \(x = 2\) par curve ka gradient nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Upar aik fraction banayein; \(x - a\) minus ke saath aata hai aur cancel ho jata hai.

book_ref.quote: is called the derivative or gradient of

blocks.prompt:
5 Find from first principles the derivative of \(f(x) = x^{3} - 2x\). (5 marks)
(First principles se \(f(x) = x^{3} - 2x\) ka derivative nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Chaar qadam; \((x + \delta x)^{3}\) ko khol lein.

book_ref.quote: can be found by the following four steps

steps: Step II: \(f(x + \delta x) - f(x) = x^{3} + 3x^{2}\delta x + 3x(\delta x)^{2} + (\delta x)^{3} - 2x - 2\delta x - x^{3} + 2x\)
Step III: \(\delta x\) se taqseem: \(3x^{2} + 3x\,\delta x + (\delta x)^{2} - 2\)

blocks.prompt:
6 Find from first principles the derivative of \(f(x) = \sqrt{3x + 1}\) and the gradient of its graph at \(x = 5\). (5 marks)
(First principles se \(f(x) = \sqrt{3x + 1}\) ka derivative aur \(x = 5\) par us ke graph ka gradient nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(\delta x\) ka factor nikalne ke liye numerator ko rationalize karein.

book_ref.quote: Whenever a square root appears in the numerator of the difference quotient, rationalize the numerator

steps: Step II (rationalize karke): \(f(x + \delta x) - f(x) = \dfrac{3\delta x}{\sqrt{3x + 3\delta x + 1} + \sqrt{3x + 1}}\)
Step III: \(\delta x\) se taqseem: \(\dfrac{3}{\sqrt{3x + 3\delta x + 1} + \sqrt{3x + 1}}\)

blocks.prompt:
7 Find by definition the derivative of \(f(x) = \dfrac{x}{x + 1}\), \(x \ne -1\). (5 marks)
(Definition se \(f(x) = \dfrac{x}{x + 1}\), \(x \ne -1\) ka derivative nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Common denominator \((x + 1)(x + \delta x + 1)\) lein; numerator \(\delta x\) ban jata hai.

book_ref.quote: With fractions, the key algebra move is taking a common denominator.

steps: Step II: \(f(x + \delta x) - f(x) = \dfrac{(x + \delta x)(x + 1) - x(x + \delta x + 1)}{(x + 1)(x + \delta x + 1)}\)
Numerator \(\delta x\) bachta hai: \(f(x + \delta x) - f(x) = \dfrac{\delta x}{(x + 1)(x + \delta x + 1)}\)
Step III: \(\delta x\) se taqseem: \(\dfrac{1}{(x + 1)(x + \delta x + 1)}\)

blocks.prompt:
8 If \(y = \dfrac{1}{x^{3}}\), find \(\dfrac{dy}{dx}\) by ab-initio method and its value at \(x = -1\). (5 marks)
(Agar \(y = \dfrac{1}{x^{3}}\) ho to ab-initio tareeqe se \(\dfrac{dy}{dx}\) aur \(x = -1\) par us ki qeemat nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Common denominator, phir \(x^{3} - (x + \delta x)^{3}\) se \(-\delta x\) ka factor nikalein.

book_ref.quote: The value of \(\frac{dy}{dx}\) at \(x = -1\) is written as

steps: \(\delta x\) se taqseem: \(\dfrac{-\left[3x^{2} + 3x\,\delta x + (\delta x)^{2}\right]}{x^{3}(x + \delta x)^{3}}\)

blocks.prompt:
9 Prove that \(\dfrac{d}{dx}(x^{n}) = nx^{n-1}\) when \(n\) is a positive integer. (5 marks)
(Sabit karein ke jab \(n\) positive integer ho to \(\dfrac{d}{dx}(x^{n}) = nx^{n-1}\).)
blocks.explanation: First principles aur \((x + \delta x)^{n}\) ki binomial expansion.

book_ref.quote: We find the derivative of \(x^{n}\) when \(n\) is positive integer.

steps: \(y = x^{n}\) lein. Phir \(\delta y = (x + \delta x)^{n} - x^{n}\)
Binomial theorem: \(\delta y = \left[x^{n} + nx^{n-1}\delta x + \dfrac{n(n-1)}{2!}x^{n-2}(\delta x)^{2} + \ldots + (\delta x)^{n}\right] - x^{n}\)
\(x^{n}\) cancel, \(\delta x\) bahar: \(\delta y = \delta x\left[nx^{n-1} + \dfrac{n(n-1)}{2!}x^{n-2}\delta x + \ldots + (\delta x)^{n-1}\right]\)
Pehli term ke ilawa har term mein \(\delta x\) hai; \(\delta x \to 0\) par \(\dfrac{dy}{dx} = nx^{n-1}\)
blocks.final_answer: Sabit hua: har positive integer \(n\) ke liye \(\dfrac{d}{dx}(x^{n}) = nx^{n-1}\).

blocks.prompt:
10 Prove that \(\dfrac{d}{dx}(x^{n}) = nx^{n-1}\) when \(n\) is a negative integer (\(x \ne 0\)). (5 marks)
(Sabit karein ke jab \(n\) negative integer ho (\(x \ne 0\)) to \(\dfrac{d}{dx}(x^{n}) = nx^{n-1}\).)
blocks.explanation: \(n = -m\) rakhein (\(m\) positive integer), yaani \(y = \frac{1}{x^{m}}\); numerator mein \((x + \delta x)^{m}\) ki expansion.

book_ref.quote: Let \(n = -m\) (\(m\) is a positive integer)

steps: Binomial theorem se \(x^{m} - (x + \delta x)^{m} = -\delta x\left[mx^{m-1} + \dfrac{m(m-1)}{2!}x^{m-2}\delta x + \ldots + (\delta x)^{m-1}\right]\)
\(\delta x\) se taqseem: \(\dfrac{\delta y}{\delta x} = \dfrac{-1}{x^{m}(x + \delta x)^{m}}\left(mx^{m-1} + \ldots + (\delta x)^{m-1}\right)\)
blocks.final_answer: Sabit hua: har negative integer \(n\) ke liye \(\dfrac{d}{dx}(x^{n}) = nx^{n-1}\).

blocks.prompt:
11 Show that \(f(x) = |x|\) is continuous at \(x = 0\) but not differentiable there. (5 marks)
(Dikhayein ke \(f(x) = |x|\) \(x = 0\) par continuous hai magar differentiable nahi.)
blocks.explanation: Continuity: \(f\) ki dono taraf ki limits \(f(0)\) ke barabar. Differentiability: \(\frac{|\delta x|}{\delta x}\) ki dono taraf ki limits mukhtalif.

book_ref.quote: Now we check the differentiability of

steps: \(f(0) = 0\); dono taraf ki limits \(0\) hain, is liye \(f\) \(0\) par continuous hai.
Dono limits barabar nahi, is liye \(f'(0)\) mojood nahi.
blocks.final_answer: Sabit hua: \(|x|\) \(0\) par continuous hai magar differentiable nahi (kone par tangent nahi).

blocks.prompt:
12 Let \(f(x) = |x - 1|\). Show that \(f\) is continuous at \(x = 1\) but \(f'(1)\) does not exist. Also find \(f'(x)\) for \(x > 1\) and for \(x < 1\). (5 marks)
(\(f(x) = |x - 1|\) lein. Dikhayein ke \(f\) \(x = 1\) par continuous hai magar \(f'(1)\) mojood nahi. \(x > 1\) aur \(x < 1\) ke liye \(f'(x)\) bhi nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(|x|\) wala tareeqa, magar kona \(x = 1\) par.

book_ref.quote: A function can be continuous at a point but not necessarily differentiable there.

steps: \(f(1) = 0\); dono taraf ki limits \(0\), is liye \(f\) \(1\) par continuous.
Daayen limit \(1\), baayen limit \(-1\); barabar nahi, is liye \(f'(1)\) mojood nahi.
blocks.final_answer: \(f\) \(1\) par continuous, \(f'(1)\) mojood nahi; \(x > 1\) par \(f'(x) = 1\), \(x < 1\) par \(f'(x) = -1\).

blocks.prompt:
13 If \(c\) is a constant and \(f\) is differentiable at \(x\), prove that \(\dfrac{d}{dx}[cf(x)] = c\dfrac{d}{dx}[f(x)]\). (5 marks)
(Agar \(c\) constant ho aur \(f\) \(x\) par differentiable ho to sabit karein ke \(\dfrac{d}{dx}[cf(x)] = c\dfrac{d}{dx}[f(x)]\).)
blocks.explanation: \(y = cf(x)\) par chaar qadam, aur constant ko limit se bahar nikalein.

book_ref.quote: A constant factor can be taken out from a limit sign.

steps: \(y = cf(x)\) lein. Phir \(y + \delta y = cf(x + \delta x)\)
\(\dfrac{\delta y}{\delta x} = c\left[\dfrac{f(x + \delta x) - f(x)}{\delta x}\right]\)
Constant limit se bahar: \(\lim_{\delta x \to 0}\dfrac{\delta y}{\delta x} = c\lim_{\delta x \to 0}\dfrac{f(x + \delta x) - f(x)}{\delta x}\)

blocks.prompt:
14 If \(f\) and \(g\) are differentiable at \(x\), prove that \(\dfrac{d}{dx}[f(x) + g(x)] = \dfrac{d}{dx}[f(x)] + \dfrac{d}{dx}[g(x)]\). (5 marks)
(Agar \(f\) aur \(g\) \(x\) par differentiable hon to sabit karein ke \(\dfrac{d}{dx}[f(x) + g(x)] = \dfrac{d}{dx}[f(x)] + \dfrac{d}{dx}[g(x)]\).)
blocks.explanation: \(\phi = f + g\) lein; \(\phi\) ki tabdeeli ko \(f\) aur \(g\) ki tabdeeliyon mein baant dein.

book_ref.quote: The limit of a sum is the sum of the limits

steps: \(\phi(x) = f(x) + g(x)\) lein. Phir \(\phi(x + \delta x) = f(x + \delta x) + g(x + \delta x)\)
\(\delta x\) se taqseem: \(\dfrac{f(x + \delta x) - f(x)}{\delta x} + \dfrac{g(x + \delta x) - g(x)}{\delta x}\)
Limit (sum ki limit = limits ka sum): \(\phi'(x) = f'(x) + g'(x)\)
Difference rule isi tarah \(\phi(x) = f(x) - g(x)\) se: \(\phi'(x) = f'(x) - g'(x)\)

blocks.prompt:
15 If \(f\) and \(g\) are differentiable at \(x\), prove the product rule \([f(x)g(x)]' = f'(x)g(x) + f(x)g'(x)\). (5 marks)
(Agar \(f\) aur \(g\) \(x\) par differentiable hon to product rule \([f(x)g(x)]' = f'(x)g(x) + f(x)g'(x)\) sabit karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(f(x)g(x + \delta x)\) minus aur plus karein, phir limit theorems aur \(g\) ki continuity.

book_ref.quote: Subtracting and adding \(f(x)\,g(x + \delta x)\)

steps: \(\phi(x) = f(x)g(x)\) lein. \(\phi(x + \delta x) - \phi(x) = f(x + \delta x)g(x + \delta x) - f(x)g(x)\)
\(f(x)g(x + \delta x)\) minus aur plus: \(= [f(x + \delta x) - f(x)]g(x + \delta x) + f(x)[g(x + \delta x) - g(x)]\)
\(\delta x\) se taqseem: \(\left[\dfrac{f(x + \delta x) - f(x)}{\delta x}\right]g(x + \delta x) + f(x)\left[\dfrac{g(x + \delta x) - g(x)}{\delta x}\right]\)
Limit theorems se: \(\phi'(x) = f'(x)\lim_{\delta x \to 0}g(x + \delta x) + f(x)g'(x)\)
\(g\) differentiable hai is liye continuous: \(\lim_{\delta x \to 0}g(x + \delta x) = g(x)\); yaani \(\phi'(x) = f'(x)g(x) + f(x)g'(x)\)

blocks.prompt:
16 If \(f\) and \(g\) are differentiable at \(x\) and \(g(x) \ne 0\), prove the quotient rule \(\left(\dfrac{f(x)}{g(x)}\right)' = \dfrac{f'(x)g(x) - f(x)g'(x)}{[g(x)]^{2}}\). (5 marks)
(Agar \(f\) aur \(g\) \(x\) par differentiable hon aur \(g(x) \ne 0\) ho to quotient rule sabit karein: \(\left(\dfrac{f(x)}{g(x)}\right)' = \dfrac{f'(x)g(x) - f(x)g'(x)}{[g(x)]^{2}}\).)
blocks.explanation: Common denominator, numerator mein \(f(x)g(x)\) minus aur plus, \(\delta x\) se taqseem aur limit.

book_ref.quote: Subtracting and adding \(f(x)g(x)\) in the numerator of step (ii) gives

steps: \(\phi(x) = \dfrac{f(x)}{g(x)}\) lein. \(\phi(x + \delta x) - \phi(x) = \dfrac{f(x + \delta x)g(x) - f(x)g(x + \delta x)}{g(x)g(x + \delta x)}\)
Numerator mein \(f(x)g(x)\) minus aur plus: \(= \dfrac{1}{g(x)g(x + \delta x)}\Big[\big(f(x + \delta x) - f(x)\big)g(x) - f(x)\big(g(x + \delta x) - g(x)\big)\Big]\)
\(\delta x\) se taqseem: \(\dfrac{1}{g(x)g(x + \delta x)}\Big[\dfrac{f(x + \delta x) - f(x)}{\delta x}g(x) - f(x)\dfrac{g(x + \delta x) - g(x)}{\delta x}\Big]\)

blocks.prompt:
17 Differentiate \(y = (x^{2} + 1)(x^{3} - 2x)\) with respect to \(x\) by the product rule, and verify the answer by multiplying out first. (5 marks)
(\(y = (x^{2} + 1)(x^{3} - 2x)\) ko product rule se differentiate karein, aur pehle zarb karke jawab ki tasdeeq karein.)
blocks.explanation: Product rule (\(f = x^{2} + 1\), \(g = x^{3} - 2x\)); phir khol kar sum rule.

book_ref.quote: If \(f\) and \(g\) are differentiable at \(x\), then \(fg\) is also differentiable

blocks.prompt:
18 Differentiate \(\dfrac{x^{2} - 3x + 1}{x^{2} + 2}\) with respect to \(x\). (5 marks)
(\(\dfrac{x^{2} - 3x + 1}{x^{2} + 2}\) ko \(x\) ke lehaaz se differentiate karein.)
blocks.explanation: Quotient rule; \(x^{2} + 2\) kabhi zero nahi.

book_ref.quote: Unlike the product rule, the ORDER matters here because of the minus sign

steps: Minus ka nishan bracket ke andar har term badalta hai: numerator \(3x^{2} + 2x - 6\)

blocks.prompt:
19 If \(y = \dfrac{x^{2} + 1}{x}\), \(x \ne 0\), find \(\dfrac{dy}{dx}\) by the quotient rule and show that \(x^{2}\dfrac{dy}{dx} = x^{2} - 1\). (5 marks)
(Agar \(y = \dfrac{x^{2} + 1}{x}\), \(x \ne 0\) ho to quotient rule se \(\dfrac{dy}{dx}\) nikalein aur dikhayein ke \(x^{2}\dfrac{dy}{dx} = x^{2} - 1\).)
blocks.explanation: Quotient rule, phir \(x^{2}\) se zarb; \(y = x + x^{-1}\) likh kar tasdeeq.

book_ref.quote: then \(\frac{f}{g}\) is differentiable at

blocks.prompt:
20 A firm's profit from \(x\) units is \(P(x) = 240x - 6x^{2} - 900\). (i) Find the marginal profit when \(x = 15\). (ii) Find the number of units that gives the largest profit and that profit. (5 marks)
(Aik company ka \(x\) units se profit \(P(x) = 240x - 6x^{2} - 900\) hai. (i) \(x = 15\) par marginal profit nikalein. (ii) Kitne units par profit sab se zyada hai aur woh profit kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: Marginal profit \(= P'(x)\); sab se zyada profit wahan jahan \(P'(x) = 0\) aur \(P'\) musbat se manfi ho.

book_ref.quote: the marginal profit is the derivative of the profit function with respect to

steps: \(P'(19) = 12 > 0\), \(P'(21) = -12 < 0\): pehle barhta phir ghat'ta hai, is liye \(x = 20\) par sab se zyada.
blocks.final_answer: (i) \(x = 15\) par marginal profit \(60\) fi unit. (ii) \(20\) units par sab se zyada profit \(1500\).

blocks.prompt:
21 A particle moves along a line with \(s(t) = 2t^{3} - 15t^{2} + 24t\) metres after \(t\) seconds. Find (i) the velocity and acceleration at \(t = 3\) s, (ii) the times when the particle is at rest. (5 marks)
(Aik particle \(s(t) = 2t^{3} - 15t^{2} + 24t\) metres ke mutabiq chalta hai. (i) \(t = 3\) s par velocity aur acceleration, (ii) particle kab rukta (at rest) hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(v = s'(t)\), \(a = v'(t)\); rukne ka matlab \(v = 0\).

book_ref.quote: velocity is the derivative of the position function, and acceleration is the derivative of the velocity function

blocks.prompt:
22 The cost of building a cylindrical tank of base radius \(r\) is \(C(r) = 2000\pi r^{2} + \dfrac{32000}{r}\), \(r > 0\). Find the radius that minimizes the cost and the least cost. (5 marks)
(Base radius \(r\) wale cylindrical tank ki cost \(C(r) = 2000\pi r^{2} + \dfrac{32000}{r}\), \(r > 0\) hai. Kam se kam cost wala radius aur kam se kam cost nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(C'(r) = 0\) rakhein, \(r\) nikalein (cube root se \(r\) milta hai), dono taraf \(C'\) ka nishan dekhein.

book_ref.quote: at the lowest point of the cost curve the rate of change of cost is zero

steps: \(C'(1) < 0\), \(C'(2) > 0\): cost pehle ghat'ti phir barhti hai, is liye yahi \(r\) kam se kam cost deta hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yahan aam ghalti: \(r^{3} = \frac{8}{\pi}\) se \(r^{3} = \left(\frac{8}{\pi}\right)^{\frac{1}{3}}\) likh dena. Cube root lene se \(r\) khud milta hai, \(r^{3}\) nahi. Least cost ke liye \(r^{3} = \frac{8}{\pi}\) ka faida uthayein: \(2000\pi r^{2} = \frac{2000\pi r^{3}}{r} = \frac{16000}{r}\), is liye \(C = \frac{48000}{r}\).

blocks.prompt:
23 The value of an investment after \(t\) years is \(V(t) = 8000(1 + 0.05t)^{2}\) rupees. Find (i) the rate of change of its value after \(5\) years, (ii) its value after \(5\) years. (5 marks)
(Aik investment ki \(t\) saal baad qeemat \(V(t) = 8000(1 + 0.05t)^{2}\) rupay hai. (i) \(5\) saal baad qeemat ki rate of change, (ii) \(5\) saal baad qeemat nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Pehle square khol lein taake sirf formulas 1 se 4 lagein.

book_ref.quote: the rate of change of the investment is the derivative of

blocks.prompt:
24 The stress on a beam is \(S(x) = 600x - 2x^{3}\) Pa at \(x\) metres from the fixed end. (i) Find the rate of change of stress at \(x = 5\) m and say whether the stress is increasing or decreasing there. (ii) Find where the stress is largest and the largest stress. (5 marks)
(Aik beam par stress \(S(x) = 600x - 2x^{3}\) Pa hai (fixed end se \(x\) metre). (i) \(x = 5\) m par stress ki rate of change nikalein aur batayein stress barh raha hai ya ghat raha hai. (ii) Stress kahan sab se zyada hai aur kitna?)
blocks.explanation: \(S'(x)\) rate deta hai; sab se zyada stress wahan jahan \(S'(x) = 0\) aur \(S'\) musbat se manfi ho.

book_ref.quote: the rate of change of stress is the derivative of

steps: (i) \(S'(5) = 450\) Pa fi metre; musbat, is liye stress barh raha hai.
\(S'(9) > 0\), \(S'(11) < 0\): \(x = 10\) m par stress sab se zyada.
blocks.final_answer: (i) \(450\) Pa fi metre, barh raha hai. (ii) \(x = 10\) m par sab se zyada stress \(4000\) Pa.
